title: Pre-registration tasks
intro: General onboarding you can get through regardless of whether your results have landed yet. Nothing here needs doing right now — this is what's coming. Scoped to New UG – Home; other applicant types (international, postgraduate, exchange) see a different set.

tasks.title: Admission checks
tasks.desc: Confirms you meet your offer conditions (grades, references, documents) and requires sign-off on the University's admissions policy.

tasks.title: Equivalent qualification check (ELQ)
tasks.desc: A UK funding-eligibility rule for students who already hold a degree at the same level or higher — affects whether you can get government student finance for a second one.

tasks.title: Fee information
tasks.desc: Confirms your tuition fee status and rate for 2026-27. How you'll actually arrange payment comes later, once registration opens.

tasks.title: Funding calculator & budgeting
tasks.desc: Tools to estimate your government funding entitlement and plan a student budget.

tasks.title: Refund policy
tasks.desc: Explains the University's policy on refunding tuition fees, for example if you withdraw.

tasks.title: Sponsor letter
tasks.desc: If a third party — an employer, government body, or scholarship scheme — is sponsoring your fees, this is where you upload their sponsorship letter.

tasks.title: IT account activation
tasks.desc: Activate your University IT account, email, and password — the first thing you'll need once you accept your place.

tasks.title: Passport / ID verification
tasks.desc: Verifying your passport or identity document — an early admissions step, done well before enrolment.

tasks.title: Health
tasks.desc: Register with a doctor and share any relevant health information.

tasks.title: Mentoring
tasks.desc: Sign up for a peer mentoring scheme.

tasks.title: Parent/guardian consent
tasks.desc: Parental or guardian consent, required specifically for entrants under 18.

tasks.title: Policy pack
tasks.desc: A bundle of one-time acknowledgements: data protection notice, equality policy, your rights, the University's general regulations, student code of conduct, academic integrity policy, complaints procedure, and freedom of speech/expression policy.

tasks.title: Community, welcome & location
tasks.desc: General welcome and orientation content, local community information, and where things are on campus and in the city.
